products.name: IBM FlashSystem 5200
products.summary: An all-flash storage system designed for mid-range enterprise workloads. Provides high availability through redundant components, IBM FlashCore technology for consistent low latency, and built-in data reduction (compression and deduplication).
capabilities: High availability with no single point of failure
IBM HyperSwap for transparent failover between sites
Inline data compression and deduplication
IBM Spectrum Virtualize software for storage virtualisation
Support for iSCSI, Fibre Channel, and NVMe-oF host connectivity
Encryption at rest using FIPS 140-2 validated drives
Replication to on-premises or IBM Cloud for disaster recovery
limitations: HyperSwap requires two storage systems at separate sites — validate site topology with a specialist
Maximum raw capacity scales with enclosure count — sizing must be confirmed for specific workloads
Replication bandwidth requirements must be assessed for the customer's network
needs_validation: Compatibility with existing host bus adapters and switches

products.name: IBM FlashSystem 7300
products.summary: A high-performance all-flash storage array for demanding enterprise workloads requiring consistent sub-millisecond latency. Includes IBM FlashCore Modules with inline AI-driven compression and built-in ransomware detection.
capabilities: Sub-millisecond latency for high-throughput workloads
IBM FlashCore Modules with inline AI-powered compression
Cyber resilience: built-in ransomware detection using statistical anomaly analysis
IBM HyperSwap for active-active high availability across two sites
IBM Safeguarded Copy for immutable, air-gapped backup snapshots
Encryption at rest with FIPS 140-2 validated drives
IBM Spectrum Virtualize for unified management across heterogeneous storage
limitations: Higher performance tier — validate whether workload requirements justify the additional capability
Safeguarded Copy schedules must be planned; recovery from immutable copies requires a tested runbook
AI-driven compression effectiveness depends on data type — validate with a proof of concept for specific workloads
needs_validation: Ransomware detection sensitivity tuning for specific data patterns
Safeguarded Copy retention schedule and recovery runbook

products.name: IBM Spectrum Virtualize
products.summary: Software that virtualises heterogeneous storage arrays into a single managed pool, enabling workload migration, thin provisioning, and replication across existing and new storage hardware without disruption.
capabilities: Virtualisation of third-party storage arrays into a unified pool
Non-disruptive data migration between storage systems
Thin provisioning and automated tiering
Synchronous and asynchronous replication for disaster recovery
IBM HyperSwap for active-active HA across two sites
IBM Safeguarded Copy for immutable point-in-time recovery
Consistent management interface across IBM FlashSystem family
limitations: Virtualising third-party arrays requires a compatibility check against the IBM Interoperability Matrix
Replication performance depends on inter-site bandwidth and latency
Non-disruptive migration timelines depend on data volume and I/O load
needs_validation: Compatibility of existing third-party storage with Spectrum Virtualize
Network bandwidth for replication and migration

products.name: IBM Cloud Object Storage
products.summary: Highly scalable, durable object storage for unstructured data such as backup, archive, and large-scale analytics. Available on-premises (IBM Cloud Object Storage System) or as a managed IBM Cloud service.
capabilities: Petabyte-scale storage for unstructured and backup data
Erasure coding for data durability without full replication overhead
S3-compatible API for broad application integration
On-premises deployment (IBM Cloud Object Storage System) or IBM Cloud managed service
Integration with IBM Spectrum Protect for backup targets
Data encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest
Policy-based lifecycle management for automated tiering and expiry
limitations: Object storage is optimised for large, infrequently-modified objects — not a replacement for block storage in transactional workloads
Erasure coding schemes must be selected based on durability and space efficiency trade-offs
On-premises deployment requires physical hardware planning
needs_validation: Data type and access patterns — confirm object storage is appropriate for the workload
Durability and erasure coding scheme selection
Network throughput for ingest and retrieval

products.name: IBM Spectrum Protect (Tivoli Storage Manager)
products.summary: Enterprise backup and recovery software that protects data across physical, virtual, and cloud environments. Supports policy-based automation, deduplication, and integration with IBM Cloud Object Storage for long-term retention.
capabilities: Policy-driven automated backup for physical and virtual workloads
Client-side and server-side data deduplication
Integration with IBM Cloud Object Storage and tape for tiered retention
Replication to an off-site Spectrum Protect server for disaster recovery
IBM Spectrum Protect Plus for VM-centric snapshot and recovery
Reporting and compliance dashboards for backup coverage
Supports major operating systems, databases, and hypervisors
limitations: Initial configuration and policy design requires specialist expertise
Deduplication effectiveness varies by data type
Spectrum Protect Plus is a separate product with its own licensing — confirm which variant fits the use case
needs_validation: Recovery time and recovery point objectives for each workload class
Compatibility with existing hypervisors and databases

products.name: IBM Guardium Data Protection
products.summary: A data activity monitoring and protection platform that provides real-time visibility into data access, enforces policies, and generates audit trails for compliance across structured and unstructured data stores.
capabilities: Real-time monitoring of data access across databases, data warehouses, and file systems
Automated policy enforcement and alerting on anomalous access
Tamper-proof audit trails for compliance (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR)
Vulnerability assessment for database misconfigurations and unpatched risks
Data discovery and classification to identify sensitive data locations
Integration with SIEM platforms for centralised security operations
limitations: Deployment and policy tuning requires security and DBA expertise
Coverage depends on supported data source connectors — validate against customer's database versions
Compliance reporting templates are framework-specific — confirm which regulations apply
needs_validation: Integration with existing SIEM or security operations tools
